capabilities: Render month, week, day, and agenda views from a md-calendar code block
Create and edit events and tasks with recurrence, colors, and notes
Drag events to reschedule, resize, and copy them
Copy the visible period as a Markdown list
Delete past records to keep the calendar note small
disambiguation: Not a sync for external calendar services; all events and tasks are stored only inside the note's code block.
extras: The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Includes a status-bar display of the next upcoming event and per-calendar hour/zoom settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar view, so scheduling events and day tasks means leaving the vault or scattering them across daily notes.
summary: Renders a full calendar (month/week/day/agenda) from a JSON code block in one Markdown note, with events, tasks, and recurrence.
